hypotheses.statement: Dispatchers re-open the handover photo before they confirm a parcel.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Both dispatchers describe re-checking the photo before confirming, unprompted.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Neither dispatcher mentions checking the photo before confirming.

hypotheses.statement: Dispatchers want a bulk confirm for returned parcels.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Both dispatchers ask for one action that confirms several parcels at once.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Neither dispatcher asks for it and both finish the task one parcel at a time without complaint.

instrument.intro: Thank you for your time. We are learning how the handover queue works for you. There are no wrong answers and you can stop at any time.
instrument.consent: With your permission I will take notes and keep them without your name. Is that all right?
instrument.closing: Thank you. Is there anything I should have asked and did not?

questions.text: Tell me about the last time you handled returned parcels.
Please confirm the returned parcels in the queue the way you normally would.
